description: Build the public product entry page and protected dashboard flow: owner creates tenant/project, invites member, subscribes via Stripe Checkout, webhook grants entitlement, and triggers welcome email. Corresponds to subtask 2.4.
steps: Create app/page.tsx as the public product entry/landing page with sign-in/sign-up links, product description, and pricing info
Create app/auth/login/page.tsx and app/auth/signup/page.tsx with Supabase Auth forms (email/password) using @supabase/ssr for cookie-based sessions
Create app/auth/callback/route.ts for Supabase Auth OAuth/magic-link callback handling
Create middleware.ts for Next.js middleware that protects /dashboard/* routes - redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login
Create app/dashboard/layout.tsx as the authenticated dashboard shell with navigation (tenants, projects, billing, settings)
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx as the dashboard home showing user's tenants list
Create app/dashboard/tenants/new/page.tsx with Server Action to create a new tenant (validates name, creates tenant with current user as owner, creates owner membership)
Create app/dashboard/tenants/[tenantId]/page.tsx showing tenant details, projects list, and members list
Create app/dashboard/tenants/[tenantId]/projects/new/page.tsx with Server Action to create a project within the tenant (enforces tenant membership)
Create app/dashboard/tenants/[tenantId]/members/invite/page.tsx with Server Action to invite a member by email (enforces owner/admin role, sends invite via MailPort, creates pending membership)
Create app/dashboard/tenants/[tenantId]/billing/page.tsx showing subscription status and Stripe billing portal link; includes subscribe button that creates Stripe Checkout session

Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts as the Stripe webhook endpoint: reads raw body, passes to WebhookVerifier, on valid+new event dispatches to billing handler for subscription state updates, triggers welcome email on first subscription activation
All Server Actions must: validate input, check authentication via requireAuth, check authorization via domain policies, use transactions for multi-step mutations, return sanitized errors on failure
Use Tailwind CSS for all UI components with consistent design system
Ensure all state-changing operations have explicit commit points - failures before commit preserve pre-operation state
acceptance_criteria: Public landing page renders at / without authentication
Authentication flow works with Supabase Auth (login/signup/callback)
Middleware redirects unauthenticated users from /dashboard/* to /auth/login
Owner can create a tenant and project through the dashboard
Owner/admin can invite members (sends email via MailPort)
Billing page shows subscription status and allows subscribing via Stripe Checkout
Stripe webhook endpoint verifies signature before processing, rejects invalid signatures with non-success status
Webhook processes subscription events idempotently (deduplicates by provider_event_id)
Welcome email triggers on first subscription activation
All protected actions enforce deny-by-default authorization
findings: All routes build correctly. Landing page is static (pre-rendered), all auth/dashboard pages are dynamic (server-rendered on demand) due to cookies() usage. Added @eslint/eslintrc as devDependency and created eslint.config.mjs for ESLint flat config support. Middleware uses @supabase/ssr pattern for session refresh on each request. Stripe webhook reads raw body text before signature verification. FakeBillingAdapter is used when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY or STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET are placeholder values.
